item.text:
It provides small order helpers: calculate an order total, apply named percentage discounts, compute an average, and format an order receipt.

Bugs:

- `calcTotal` loops with `i <= items.length`; the final iteration accesses `items[items.length]` (undefined), causing a `TypeError`. Use `i < items.length`.
- `averageItemPrice` divides the total order value by item-line count, so it is not an average per individual item when quantities exceed 1. It also returns `NaN` for an empty array.
